intent: Kept /wsg/ videos go to the dufs cloud folder (or ~/Downloads as fallback) instead of a buried data dir, and trash/ is capped at the newest 200 passes with everything older deleted.
scope: python_pkg/wsg_grabber/paths.py: cloud_root, downloads_dir, cloud_keep_dir, keep_dir (cloud or Downloads), legacy_keep_dir, kept_candidates
python_pkg/wsg_grabber/_prune.py, _migrate_keep.py, housekeeping.py (new); files.remove; FileState.PURGED; store_verdicts recent_passed_names / purge_older_passes / rename_kept
app.py wires on_startup / after_verdict / locate_reviewed; cli.py and README drop the 'nothing is ever deleted' promise
Non-goal: capping kept files, touching dufs-cloud or the media sync timer
changes: keep_dir() resolves per call to ~/data/cloud/Media/<year>/wsg when the cloud folder exists, else ~/Downloads
prune_trash deletes every trash/ file outside the 200 newest reviewed_at passes (orphans included) and marks the rows purged; runs at startup and after each pass
migrate_keep moves the legacy keep/ into the current keep dir once (dedupe by name+size, suffix + index rename on clash) and removes the empty dir
undo locates a kept file through kept_candidates so year rollover, cloud absence and the media sync sweep do not lose the verdict

keep/ 342 -> ~/data/cloud/Media/2026/wsg 647 (was 305), keep/ gone; trash 23218 files / 77G -> 200 files / 823M; stats: kept 648, passed 200, purged 23018

risks: Purging is irreversible; the first run deleted 77 GB of passed videos, as agreed (Q3).

A keep made while the cloud folder is absent lands in ~/Downloads and is swept by media-cloud-sync into Media/<year>/<month>; undo follows it via kept_candidates but a same-name suffix applied by that sync would break the link.
Kept videos in Media/<year>/wsg now appear in the dufs gallery and get thumbnails.
rollback: git revert the commit; kept files stay in the cloud folder (undo will still find them there through the old keep_dir only if moved back by hand)
